First, we write out the inner summation by summing over the index $i:$

$$
\begin{aligned}{\sum }_{j=1}^{3}{\sum }_{i=1}^{3}\frac{i}{j} & ={\sum }_{j=1}^{3}[{\sum }_{i=1}^{3}\frac{i}{j}] \\  & ={\sum }_{j=1}^{3}(\frac{1}{j}+\frac{2}{j}+\frac{3}{j}) \\  & ={\sum }_{j=1}^{3}\frac{6}{j}\end{aligned}
$$

Next, we sum over the index $j:$

$$
\begin{aligned}{\sum }_{j=1}^{3}\frac{6}{j} & =\frac{6}{1}+\frac{6}{2}+\frac{6}{3} \\  & =6+3+2 \\  & =11\end{aligned}
$$
